news.text: Regarding Mateo #Pellegrino, we had spoken about a meeting in Milan between #Parma and #Fiorentina post mid-June. #Parma had inquired about #Piccoli who is now the center of other interests. #Pellegrino has waited and continues to wait for #Juventus which is now also focused on #Zirkzee.[Alfredo Pedullà]

🚨 The #Fiorentina track for Mateo #Pellegrino has held strong since mid June, when we exclusively revealed it, and still valid. The viola are searching for a new club for #Piccoli and are targeting the Argentine from #Parma who has been waiting for #Juventus for weeks and could break his hesitation in favor of the viola if there is an acceleration to finalize his exit from the ducali.[Gianluigi Longari]

#Lucumí: new dialogues on the way between #Juventus and #Bologna. The emiliano club is now asking for 20 millions plus bonuses, while #Juve is starting from a lower figure. For now, #Lucumí continues to wait despite other offers.[Alfredo Pedullà]

🇳🇱⚠️ "There are some initial whispers on #Koopmeiners, it's true. I verified and found some confirmations about an exploratory attempt by English clubs, such as #Newcastle, but not only. We will see if these whispers will lead to a much more concrete situation, as #Juventus would prefer, since they do not consider him untouchable: someone will have to leave after all." [Alfredo Pedullà - Youtube via @juventusinsidernews]

😱 SUITORS FOR #KOOPMEINERS#Napoli has asked for information, in recent hours, for Teun #Koopmeiners. The Dutch midfielder is on the balance sheet for roughly 33 million - approximately - as of last July, and could leave if permanent offers arrive. In recent days, he has also been followed by #ManchesterUnited and #AstonVilla.[TuttoJuve via @AverageJuventinoGuy]

#Atlético is looking for a way to let Alexander #Sørloth leave and is asking around 40 million euros for the transfer.The Norwegian striker is open to moving to the Turkish league, but only in exchange for a very lucrative contract.If #Sørloth were to leave, #Atlético would go after Dušan #Vlahović. #Beşiktaş is also after #Vlahović.[Matteo Moretto]

🇧🇷🧐 #Everton is interested in #DouglasLuiz, but he replied "No, thank you": he is becoming increasingly convinced that staying could be the right choice. #Spalletti is involving him a lot, even though no decision on his future has been made. He has admirers in the Premier League, but for now, the idea is to seek redemption as a bianconero and prove his worth. The coach is studying how to deploy him: he believes his qualities can make a difference in his style of football.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇨🇴🔛 "Even today, there have been contacts between #Juventus-#Bologna for #Lucumí. There is still a gap, but the two clubs continue to talk and work continues in this track, trying to use the player's 'yes' card."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

🇳🇱🆙 "For the attack, #Spalletti is becoming increasingly convinced on #Zirkzee, #Massara's favorite. #ManchesterUnited has opened to a loan with an option to buy, without an obligation. #Juventus is accelerating because it is an economically sustainable formula. He is not the physically strong center-forward in the box who excels in the air that the coach usually likes, but he drifts across the front line and does not give opponents any reference points."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤⁉️ "For the goal, many names have been proposed: #Trubin, #Ederson, #Pickford and #MilinkovicSavic. Evaluations are underway, but #Juventus's, however, remains #Suzuki. There is also #Vicario: the bianconero club already has his 'yes', he earns around €4M and #Tottenham would even let him leave on a free loan with an option to buy, but #Spalletti is not particularly convinced by this name."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇨🇴🧐 "#Juventus is looking for a defender and I continue to point to #Lucumí, who is #Spalletti's first choice. There is competition from the Premier League and now the price tag is at €25M. The bianconeri are offering €17M, #NottinghamForest €20M, but he prefers the Piedmont club, with whom an agreement in principle is already in place for a five-year contract worth €2.5M + bonuses. #Bologna, however, wants €25M and is not interested in other players in exchange."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀🔛 "In these hours, #Massara and #Ottolini are working in Milan, together with #Carnevali and with #Chiellini as a point of reference. The fact that the management has remained operational is symptomatic with a #Juventus that is active on the mercato. From a distance, the coach confers daily with the directors. There is total harmony and he trusts them: the arrivals have given him confidence. Eyes wide open: in the silence, la Vecchia Signora is absolutely making some moves."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤🧐 #Juventus has decided to postpone its project to secure a goalkeeper until the summer of 2027. Limited economic resources, the lack of a domino effect and the high costs of top players have put the plans on hold. #PSG is about to finalize the signing of #Suzuki for around €35M, but the bianconeri are hoping for a simple loan, delaying everything until next year. The #Vicario and #Atubolu tracks remain alive, but the main target continues to be the Japanese.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🧐❗️"I think #Juventus must follow three main moves:1⃣ If they manage to get the goalkeeper on loan, then good, otherwise they will go for #Vicario, who can arrive on loan with an option to buy, or look at another track;2⃣ #Lucumí is waiting, he said 'no' to other offers and ideally he goes to sleep wearing the bianconero shirt. You cannot keep him waiting forever: the deal needs to be closed or he will go elsewhere;3⃣ The third can be #Zirkzee. It is an important opportunity, he could be signed even without selling #David, possibly postponing the sale until later. It would be a risk, but it's a possibility."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
